# Code Generator - UniversalCodeMaker.com

> A 100% free, privacy-first, client-side web application for generating static QR codes, 2D matrix codes, and over 50 industrial and retail 1D barcode standards. Zero sign-up, zero data tracking, permanent codes that never expire.

## Core Capabilities
- **Static QR Codes**: Standard QR, Micro QR, custom dot styles, corner frames, color gradients, and centered logos.
- **Smart QR Payloads**: Wi-Fi auto-connect, vCard 3.0/4.0 contact cards, Crypto payment addresses (BTC, ETH, SOL), iCal calendar events, direct phone/SMS/email links.
- **Retail Barcodes**: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ISBN-13 (Books), ISSN (Magazines).
- **Logistics & Industrial**: Code 128 (Auto/A/B/C), GS1-128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, Codabar, MSI Plessey, Pharmacode.
- **2D Matrix Codes**: Aztec Code, Data Matrix (ECC 200), PDF417, MicroPDF417, DotCode, MaxiCode.
- **Export Formats**: Vector SVG (infinite scale), Print-ready PNG (1x Web, 2x Retina, 4x 300+ DPI), multi-label printable PDF sheets (Avery 5160, 5163, L7160), and batch ZIP download.

## Technical & Privacy Guarantee
- All barcode encoding and rendering occurs 100% client-side in the user's browser memory via JavaScript (`bwip-js` and `qr-code-styling`).
- No user inputs, URLs, passwords, or generated images are ever transmitted to or stored on our servers.
- Codes are true static symbols with direct data encoding and no proprietary redirect servers.
